hero.titleBefore: There is room for you in
hero.text: Feline Fairies is a foster-based rescue powered by people who give their time, their homes, and their care. Choose the path that fits you.

items.label: Open your home
items.title: Foster
items.text: Give a cat a safe place to settle while they wait for adoption.

items.label: Give your time
items.title: Volunteer
items.text: Support the everyday work of a volunteer-run rescue in ways that fit your skills.

items.label: Welcome a companion
items.title: Adopt
items.text: Meet cats and kittens looking for a loving home.

items.label: Support their care
items.title: Donate
items.text: Help provide food, supplies, foster needs, and basic medical care.

community.title: Small acts add up to second chances.
community.text: Some people can welcome a cat home. Others can offer a few hours, help share a listing, or make a gift. Each contribution supports the work around a cat’s next chapter.
